title: Sample-efficient prediction of high-entropy alloy strength through outcome-aware robust sequential learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18462v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate prediction of high-entropy alloy (HEA) strength can guide composition and processing decisions; however, obtaining tensile-test data for HEAs can be costly and experimentally demanding. This study proposes Robust Outcome-aware Sequential Experimentation for High-Entropy Alloys (ROSE-HEA), a sample-efficient framework for predicting ultimate tensile strength (UTS) from alloy composition and processing conditions. Its acquisition policy anticipates how possible UTS outcomes update predictions and the support for complementary Gaussian process (GP) descriptions. It then reassesses the worst-case expected predictive risk remaining across a reference domain to select informative candidates. A retrospective evaluation on 501 HEA records compares ROSE-HEA with expected-improvement (EI) and upper-confidence-bound (UCB) Bayesian optimization (BO), random GP sampling, and eight conventional regressors across 30 matched runs with shared in

translated_title: 基于结果感知的鲁棒序贯学习实现高熵合金强度的样本高效预测
translated_abstract: 准确预测高熵合金（HEA）的强度可以指导成分设计与加工工艺决策；然而，获取高熵合金的拉伸试验数据成本高昂且实验要求苛刻。本研究提出了面向高熵合金的鲁棒结果感知序贯实验框架（ROSE-HEA），这是一个根据合金成分和加工条件预测抗拉强度（UTS）的样本高效框架。其采集策略会预判各种可能的UTS结果将如何更新预测以及各互补高斯过程（GP）描述的支持程度，随后在参考域上重新评估剩余的最坏情况期望预测风险，从而选择信息量最大的候选点。在一项基于501条高熵合金记录的回顾性评估中，研究在30次共享相同初始数据的匹配运行下，将ROSE-HEA与期望改进（EI）和置信上界（UCB）贝叶斯优化（BO）、随机GP采样以及八种传统回归器进行了比较。
tldr: 本文提出ROSE-HEA框架，通过预判实验结果对预测的更新影响并评估最坏情况下的期望预测风险来选择信息量最大的候选实验，从而以更少的拉伸试验数据高效预测高熵合金的抗拉强度。
en_tdlr: ROSE-HEA is an outcome-aware robust sequential learning framework that selects informative experiments by anticipating how possible outcomes update predictions and reassessing worst-case expected predictive risk, enabling sample-efficient prediction of high-entropy alloy tensile strength.
